Immaḍidevarāya
Devarāya II of Vijayanagar, A.D. 1425-1446.
--Mahānāṭakasūktisudhānidhi (ascribed to him but written perhaps by Śoṇādrinātha; see one of the colophonic verses in his Rāmābhyudaya, Sources of Vij. His., 1919, p. 85). Adyar D. V. 588. MD. 12762-9. MT. 609 (c).
Critically ed. in the Skt. Dept., University of Madras.
--Brahmasūtravṛtti Pampā (ascribed to him). Mysore II. p. 22. See Vij. Sexcent. Vol. 1936. p.. 377-80.

Immaḍidevarāya
or prauDhadevarAya
--Ratiratnapradīpikā. kāmaśāstra. MD. 15280. Mysore I. p. 306 (Immaḍi Devarāya). a. same a. the previous ?

Immaḍidevarāya
1446-65 A.D.; name of Mallikārjuna, son of Prauḍha Devarāya (i.e. Devarāya II) of Vijayanagar; a. his instance, Kallinātha wrote his C. on the Saṅgītaratnākara (S. R., I. Intro. verses 7-14).
